4604.synonym: nāyaka, ninnetar, netar, netta, vināyaka, venayika
4604.commentary: (DNa) netā'ti taṃ taṃ atthaṃ dassento paññāya netā. vividhāni kāraṇāni dassento netī'ti vinetā. punappunaṃ netī'ti anunetā.

4617.commentary: (ANa) anupakkuṭṭho'ti na upakkuṭṭho, na akkosaṃ vā nindaṃ vā pattapubbo.

examples.text: khattiyo nāma ubhato sujāto hoti, mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko, yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakuṭṭho jātivādena.

4618.meaning1: not the action (of another person); not the effort (of another); not (by) attack
4618.meaning2: not the action (of another); not an act of violence

examples.text: aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso, yaṃ par'ūpakkamena tathāgataṃ jīvitā voropeyya. anupakkamena, bhikkhave, tathāgatā parinibbāyanti.

4619.meaning1: not a defilement; not a corruption

examples.text: satt'ime, brāhmaṇa, bojjh'aṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anupakkilesā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimutti-phalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti. katame satta?

4621.commentary: (MNa) anupakkuṭṭho'ti na upakuṭṭho, na akkosaṃ vā nindaṃ vā pattapubbo. kena kāraṇenā'ti. jātivādena, iti'pi hīnajātiko eso'ti evarūpena vacanenā'ti attho.

examples.text: bhavañ'hi caṅkī ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.

4623.commentary: (DNa) anupakkhandatī'ti anupavisati. idaṃ, sace tvaṃ pasādavasena samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gantu'kāmo, gaccha, mā brāhmaṇassa samayaṃ bhindī'ti adhippāyena āhaṃsu.

examples.text: apavadat'eva bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo vaṇṇaṃ, apavadati mante, apavadati jātiṃ ek'aṃsena. bhavaṃ soṇadaṇḍo samaṇass'eva gotamassa vādaṃ anupakkhandatī'ti.

4625.meaning1: having placed; having put; having inserted (something in-between)

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, sīhaseyyā? sīho, bhikkhave, migarājā dakkhiṇena passena seyyaṃ kappeti, pāde pādaṃ accādhāya, antarasatthimhi naṅguṭṭhaṃ anupakkhipitvā. so paṭibujjhitvā purimaṃ kāyaṃ abbhunnāmetvā pacchimaṃ kāyaṃ anuviloketi.

4626.meaning1: sneaking in; encroaching; intruding; forcing oneself in

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre jānaṃ pubb'upagataṃ bhikkhuṃ anupakhajja seyyaṃ kappeyya, yassa sambādho bhavissati, so pakkamissatī'ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
tassa evam'assa, ayaṃ kho gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, so ca ārakkhasampanno, n'āyaṃ sukaro pasayha jīvitā voropetuṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ anupakhajja jīvitā voropeyyan'ti

imaṃ me nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ migajātā anupakhajja mucchitā bhojanāni bhuñjissanti, anupakhajja mucchitā bhojanāni bhuñjamānā madaṃ āpajjissanti, mattā samānā pamādaṃ āpajjissanti, pamattā samānā yathākāmakaraṇīyā bhavissanti imasmiṃ nivāpe'ti.

4631.commentary: (MNa) anupetī'ti anuyāti. anupagacchatī'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ, anugacchatī'ti'pi attho, ubhayenā'pi upeti upagacchatī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: cātumahābhūtiko ayaṃ puriso yadā kālaṅ'karoti, pathavī pathavīkāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, āpo āpokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, tejo tejokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, vāyo vāyokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, ākāsaṃ indriyāni saṅkamanti.
kiṃ pana bho gotamo ādīnavaṃ sampassamāno evaṃ imāni sabbaso diṭṭhigatāni anupagato'ti?

so lābhasakkāraṃ jigucchanto pabbajjaṃ anupagantvā, pahomi c'āhaṃ lābh'ālābh'ādīsu nibbikāro hotun'ti attānaṃ takkento, visesato para-paribhava-sahan'ādi-paṭipadaṃ pūrento upekkhāpāramiṃ matthakaṃ pāpessāmī'ti

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati arakkhiten'eva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya arakkhitena cittena, anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā, asaṃvutehi indriyehi.

tattha n'atthi hantā vā ghātetā vā sotā vā sāvetā vā viññātā vā viññāpetā vā. yo'pi tiṇhena satthena sīsaṃ chindati, na koci kañci jīvitā voropeti. sattannaṃtv'eva kāyānam'antarena satthaṃ vivaram'anupatati.
hatthibandhaṃ assabandhaṃ, gopurisañ'ca maṇḍalaṃ, chavaḍāhakaṃ pupphachaḍḍakaṃ, sadhanam'anupatanti nāriyo.
duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkha-anupatita-addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.
pamādo rajo pamādo, pamāda-anupatito rajo, appamādena vijjāya, abbahe sallam'attano'ti.
yasmā ca kho, mahāli, rūpaṃ sukhaṃ sukha-anupatitaṃ sukh'āvakkantaṃ anavakkantaṃ dukkhena, tasmā sattā rūpasmiṃ sārajjanti, sārāgā saṃyujjanti, saṃyogā saṃkilissanti.
seyyathā'pi, gahapati, gijjho vā kaṅko vā kulalo vā maṃsapesiṃ ādāya uḍḍīyeyya. tam'enaṃ gijjhā'pi kaṅkā'pi kulalā'pi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitaccheyyuṃ vissajjeyyuṃ.

ahañ'hi pubbe hatthim'pi dhāvantaṃ anupatitvā gaṇhāmi, assam'pi dhāvantaṃ anupatitvā gaṇhāmi, ratham'pi dhāvantaṃ anupatitvā gaṇhāmi, migam'pi dhāvantaṃ anupatitvā gaṇhāmi, atha ca pan'āhaṃ imaṃ samaṇaṃ pakatiyā gacchantaṃ sabbathāmena gacchanto na sakkomi sampāpuṇitun'ti!
bhikkhu siyā jhāyī vimuttacitto, ākaṅkhe ce hadayassa-anupattiṃ, lokassa ñatvā udayabbayañ'ca, sucetaso anissito tadānisaṃso'ti.

examples.text: app'eva nāma mayam'pi āyasmantānaṃ kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyyāmā'ti. evañ'ca so bhikkhu vatvā kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyya antamaso piṇḍapātamattam'pi, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

examples.text: atha kho, so bhikkhave, mahājanakāyo caturāsīti pāṇasahassāni kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā vipassiṃ bodhisattaṃ agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitaṃ anupabbajiṃsu.

4698.meaning1: following (of) into the monastic life; renunciation (under)
4698.commentary: (SNa) anupabbajjan'ti ariyesu cittaṃ pasādetvā gharā nikkhamma tesaṃ santike pabbajjaṃ. ariyānañ'hi santike cittaṃ pasādetvā tesaṃ'y'eva santike pabbajitvā tesaṃ'y'eva ovād'ānusāsaniṃ paccāsīsamānassa carato'pi pabbajjā anupabbajjā nāma. ariyesu pasādena aññattha pabbajitvā ariyānaṃ santike ovādānusāsaniṃ paccāsīsamānassa carato pabbajjā'pi anupabbajjā nāma. aññesu pana pasādena aññesaṃ'y'eva santike pabbajitvā aññesaṃ'y'eva ovād'ānusāsaniṃ paccāsīsamānassa carato pabbajjā anupabbajjā nāma na hoti

examples.text: payirupāsanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi, anussatim'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi, anupabbajjam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi.
